findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) 4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

1) (REPEAT x2) On arrival the dish machine would not register on the inspector’s CL test strips. The quat test strips showed a little color change but was not sufficient for quat sanitizing either. The PIC was consulted and replaced the jug of quat concentrate with a CL concentrate jug. Once primed the registered correctly on both the inspector’s and facility’s test strips. 2) On arrival the sani bucket would not register correctly on the inspector’s test strips. The bucket was remade by staff to correct. Ensure that the sanitizers in the facility are at effective levels at all times.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11.

On arrival the dish machine would not register on the inspector test strips (CL sanitizer). The concentrate jug was observed empty and replaced. The new jug would not register on the test strips either, even when the jug itself was tested. A third jug was attached to the machine and then produced the needed concentration of CL in solution for effective sanitization of dishes. Ensure that the sanitizers in the facility are at effective levels at all times.

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM. [C]

When inspection began there was no certified food program manager (CFM) present. CORRECTED- a person with a CFM arrived halfway through the inspection. Ensure there is a CFM present at all times food is being handled.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-501.114(A) Manual and Mechanical Warewashing Equipment, Chemical Sanitization - Temperature, pH, Concentration, and Hardness. A chemical SANITIZER used in a SANITIZING solution for a manual or mechanical operation at contact times specified under 4-703.11(C) shall meet the criteria specified under §7-204.11 Sanitizers, Criteria, shall be used in accordance with the EPA-registered label use instructions, and shall be used as follows: (A) A chlorine solution shall have a minimum temperature based on the concentration and PH of the solution as listed in the chart in 4-501.114 (A). [P]

The dish machine was observed to be dispensing 0 ppm Cl. The person in charge was notified and will be making a call to have the machine serviced. Use the triple sink to sanitize dishes until the dish machine is observed to be dispensing 200 ppm. A follow up inspection is scheduled for 07/28/25 (3 days would be Saturday 07/26/25) to check the dish machine.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.citation_text:
4-302.14 Sanitizing Solutions, Testing Devices. A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

On arrival only test strips for the quaternary ammonia sanitizer used for sani buckets are available. The dish machine is CL based and required a separate test strips to check. The situation was discussed with the PIC. A new set of test strips were brought to the facility during this inspection to correct the violation. Ensure that the facility has test strips for all chemicals used on food contact surfaces in the facility at all times.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). 

Raw eggs are observed over raw vegetables in the walk in cooler. Education was conducted with the PIC and the eggs moved to correct. Ensure foods are stored so that potential contamination is not a concern.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Pink slime/mold is observed on the bottom edge of the deflector shield in the ice machine. The PIC was shown and cleaned the item during this inspection to correct. Ensure that food contact surfaces are cleaned often enough so that they remain clean.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2) 4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

On arrival, the test strips used for the sanitizers in the facility are not working effectively. They appear to have been degraded, possibly by heat or moisture. Ensure that new test strips are acquired and maintained in a usable state. A small amount was acquired during this inspection to correct the violation.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
The PERSON IN CHARGE shall: (A) FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations not conducted in private home/room with sleeping quarters;  (B) restricted access ; (C) visitors comply with Code; (D) monitor EMPLOYEES' handwashing; (E) monitor deliveries;  (F) approved source/unadulterated;  (G) proper cooking TCS Food; (H) proper cooling ; (I) monitoring temperatures; (J) consumer advisory conveyed; (K) proper sanitizing;  (L) buffets are controlled;  (M) preventing cross-contamination of RTE FOOD with bare hands; (N) EMPLOYEES are properly trained in FOOD; (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of responsibility to report information about health; (P) Written procedures and plans are maintained and implemented as required. 

The dish machine is not functioning correctly. Sanitizer concentration barely registers on inspector test strips and does not reach the 200 ppm Quat requirement for effective sanitizing. A temporary measure has been put in place until maintenance can be conducted. The maintenance person was available during this inspection and conversations were had in relation to the machine. The follow-up is being set for two weeks for compliance.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds. 

The dish machine is observed to barely register Quat sanitizer on the inspector’s test strips. Investigation showed that the jug of concentrate is only showing at 200-400ppm in solution. It is possible that the chemical is off gassing prior to use as the rate of consumption is so slow at the facility. The three part sink was set up to act as a sanitizing step as a temporary measure until that maintenance can be conducted. Refer to line item #1 for follow up.

The PERSON IN CHARGE shall: (A) FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations not conducted in private home/room with sleeping quarters;  (B) restricted access ; (C) visitors comply with Code; (D) monitor EMPLOYEES' handwashing; (E) monitor deliveries;  (F) approved source/unadulterated;  (G) proper cooking TCS Food; (H) proper cooling ; (I) monitoring temperatures; (J) consumer advisory conveyed; (K) proper sanitizing;  (L) buffets are controlled;  (M) preventing cross-contamination of RTE FOOD with bare hands; (N) EMPLOYEES are properly trained in FOOD; (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of responsibility to report information about health; (P) Written procedures and plans are maintained and implemented as required. 

The dish machine is not functioning correctly at this time. A temporary measure has been put in place until maintenance can be conducted. Follow up would normally be 10 days, due to the state fair it will be pushed back to 8/21/23.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-703.11: After cleaning, FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be SANITIZED in: (A) manual hot water operations. (B) mechanical hot water operations. (C) Chemical manual or mechanical operations. Contact times shall be consistent with those on EPA-registered label use  standard contact time 30 seconds. 

The dish machine is observed to not produce a color change on any test strips used during this inspection. The jug of concentrate tested correctly indicating an issue with the machine itself. PIC indicated that they would get maintenance to work on the machine, but that they were out making deliveries. The three part sink was set up to act as a sanitizing step as a temporary measure until that maintenance can be conducted. Refer to line item #1 for follow up.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

On arrival only a bucket of soapy water was available for wiping counters in the kitchen. PIC indicated that they usually use a spray bottle of sanitizer that they could not find. PIC searched for a few minutes and found a set of premade sanitizer wipes in a cabinet that use an acceptable chemical at correct concentration.

findings.title: Wiping cloths: properly used and stored
findings.comment:
3-304.14: (B) Cloths in-use for wiping counters and EQUIPMENT surfaces shall be held between uses in chemical sanitizer at proper solution and laundered daily. (C) Cloths in-use for wiping raw animal FOOD surfaces shall be separate from other cloths. (D) Dry wiping cloths and sanitizing solution shall be free of FOOD debris and other soil. (F) SINGLE-USE disposable sanitizer wipes shall be used in accordance with EPA labels. 

Multiple moist towels are observed on counters and microwaves during this inspection. The situation was discussed with the PIC. If spray bottles are used for wiping counters, use disposable paper towels to wipe and then discard. If cloth towels are to be used, store them in a bucket of solution (at correct concentration) between uses. Towels were removed during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

The only sets of test strips for the two chemicals used in the facility (CL and Quat) are observed moist and soiled inside of their containers. The strips were tested and did not function correctly during this inspection. No other sets of strips were available. New test strips were ordered during this inspection and should be here around 10/ 10:30 am. A small amount were acquired during this inspection to correct the immediate violation.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. 

A can on the rack next to the ice machine is observed with a deep dent in the top rim. Discussed with the PIC. PIC is aware that cans with dents along the three main seams (top, bottom and side) should be discarded to prevent possible illness. The can was discarded during the inspection to correct.
